about_the_game:
The trial version offers the first 5 maps of the full version and 4 out of 8 classes for everyone to experience. The trial version does not have an achievement system. The other content is the same as that of the full version.

The main gameplay includes normal maps, trial towers, equipment, mining, smelting, and quests.

name: 挂到1000级-Idle to level 1000 Demo
short_description: This is a 2D idle game. You can choose 8 professions to team up and fight monsters and brush equipment. By selecting different attributes for different professions and adding points, the combat effectiveness of the character can be significantly improved.
supported_languages: English, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
